reviews.comment: dr. riley is one of the best professors i've had at a&m. he's a hard advocate for students using him and his TA's to succeed. if u work hard and study for the exams (which are 65% of ur grade unfortunately) u will do just fine.

dr. riley is one of the most caring professors ive had at a&m. he really wants his students to succeed and advocates for using him and the TA's on studying and homework help. if u go to class and work hard, this should be an easy A.

The exams are only 20 MC questions and 1 work-out problem, so you could only miss 2 questions to keep an A on the test. But, the last two tests are open note and online. Lectures are engaging, lab is also online, and lab HW is an easy 100 if you ask your TA to check it. He also curves, so put in the work and you'll do fine.

Dr. Riley is probably one of the best professors I've had in this department. This course is hard, but if you ACTIVELY attend lectures, then you will get a lot more out of it. He is very passionate about the subject and wants you to understand it. You will not do good on the exams if you just memorize things on the slides.

I hate to give this rating. Dr. Riley is so sweet and has a deep passion for what he teaches. His lecture however is the most confusing material and is not presented in a way that is clear to students. Study what you can, but ultimately be ready to rely on TAs for clarification on his slides. Exams are hard bc of this.
His test questions are very hard and confusing and are not even close to the level of questions given in class.

Dr. Riley was super nice and passionate about this class! The biggest thing with him was that his lectures did not always feel the most organized, which made understanding topics challenging. If you attend class, actively take notes, and understand the homework, exams are not too bad. Lots of really cool topics too.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback

reviews.comment: Dr. Riley is an amazing professor who cares about his students greatly. The class is one of the harder ANSC classes I have taken, but I have maintained an A by utilizing the TA's via email and going to Dr. Riley anytime a topic isn't clear. Record lectures if you can, and be active in class. I will miss this professor and course despite the rigor.

Dr. Riley is a very nice guy and cares that his students understand the material. Lecture can be a little dull sometimes but Breeds is a very important class. The second exam is probably the most challenging but he gives you plenty of ways to make up for a lower score. Go to class and pay attention and you'll do fine!

Dr. Riley is amazing. Breeds is not an easy subject, but he makes lectures enjoyable through humor and helps students understand why they are learning the material. As someone who comes from a small town, it is amazing to get to learn why ranchers made the breeding decisions that they did. He greatly appreciates people who speak up in lecture.
